notes.title: May 15th Update Notes - v0.0.40
notes.content:
[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Generation 10 (Curse cards have been upgraded)
[*] [Boss: Queen Worm]
[*] [Event: Goblin Warehouse Keeper]
[*] [Event: Dream Gate]
[*] [Monster: Evil Eye] When defeated, it consumes all the player's action points.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] [Skill: Lucky Strike] Damage is now determined by a random luck value.
[*] [Skill: Draw Card Kill] Deals damage equal to twice the number of cards in the draw pile.
[*] [Skill: Discard Card Kill] Deals damage equal to twice the number of cards in the draw pile.
[*] When event options are unavailable, the text effect is also reduced.
[*] [Skill: Stealth] Changed to a destroy type.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Fixed a bug where the Hammer Trap could attack invisible monsters.
[/list]

notes.title: May 10th Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added: The 9th Generation, the will of the Dark Phantom King becomes even more terrifying.
[*] Added: [Event: In a Moment's Notice]
[*] Added: [Event: The Ghost Merchant's Deal]
[*] Added: [Skill: Stealth] Gain invisibility (enemies cannot target you).
[*] Added: [Skill: Thousand Blade Style] Control all the daggers on the field to attack the target.
[*] Added: [Skill: Deepen] Initial damage is 1, increasing by 1 point with each attack.
[*] Added: [Curse: Trickery] Randomly discard one skill from the field.
[*] Added: [Skill: Ice Sword] Inflicts 10 points of damage and 2 layers of slow, while gaining 2 points of strength.
[*] Added: [Skill: Vampiric Axe] Inflicts 10 points of damage, while gaining 5% life steal.
[*] Added: [Talent: Sanctuary] Enemies will no longer gain the will of the Phantom King.
[*] Adjusted: [Skill: Transformation] Transform into a werewolf, causing additional wounds with each subsequent attack.
[*] Adjusted: The ownership of towers and trap cards.
[*] Fixed: The relic in the Speed Force event not displaying in Chinese bug.
[*] Fixed: [Skill: Insight] Duplicate display bug.
[/list]

notes.title: May 6th Patch Notes Update——v0.0.38
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Update: 8th Generation - Regular monsters' action points have been strengthened.
[*] New: [Talent: Control] Gain the ability to drag most skills to an empty space to move them.
[*] Adjustment: [Bouncing Trap] Can bounce monsters as long as they have health.
[*] Adjustment: [Cannibal Tower] Changed to a legendary card.
[*] Adjustment: Initial skills for assassins.
[*] Adjustment: Traps now incur attack costs.
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Slash] Every multiple of turns, deal x2 damage; otherwise, deal damage equal to the number of turns.
[*] Fix: Bug where initial skills were included when choosing skills.
[*] Fix: Bug where [Skill: Weaken] could be cast on oneself.
[*] Fix: [Skill: Unseal] only works on consumable cards.
[*] Fix: Bug where [Skill: Ghost Step] wasn't removed after being used up.
[/list]

notes.title: May 2nd Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Assassin [Skill: Ghost Step] - Action points set to 99, can only be used twice.
[*] New: [Skill: Bonfire] - Reduces the strength of all enemies and restores additional health when entering a bonfire level for each skill owned.
[*] New: [Curse: Flesh Armor] - Gain an amount of armor equivalent to health value.
[*] New: [Relic: Dragon Claw] - Gain +1 strength for every 1 point of damage received.
[*] New: [Relic: Wings] - Maximum action points +1.
[*] New: [Relic: Butterfly Wings] - Action points randomly between 2 to 5 each turn.
[*] New: [Event: Old Well]
[*] New: [Event: Swift Force]
[*] New: Talent: Rare relics will be sold in shops.
[*] New: Talent: Legendary relics will be sold in shops.
[*] New: Talent: Rare skills will be sold in shops.
[*] New: Talent: Legendary skills will be sold in shops.
[*] Adjustment: After choosing skills, the game starts immediately instead of returning to the character selection screen.
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Accumulate] - Increased the damage increment.
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Filch] - Steals target's gold, and the target gains strength from being enraged.
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Metamorphose] - Decreased vampiric percentage.
[*] Fix: [Skill: Retreat] - Bug where it would also work in boss levels.
[*] Fix: [Skill: Retreat] - Bug where you could collect rewards by quitting and restarting the game after a successful retreat.
[*] Fix: Bug where negative monster strength would not take effect.
[*] Fix: [Skill: Filch] - Bug where the amount of gold stolen was not random.
[*] Fix: [Skill: Infinite Blade] - Bug where the attack damage was not affected by the number of uses.
[/list]

notes.content:
Added: Opening up the 7th Generation.
Added: [Talent: EnhanceWound] Wounds will no longer decrease.
Added: [Skill: Refresh] Opens all tiles (excluding the ones with flying monsters).
Added: [Skill: Insight] Marks tiles with hidden monsters.
Adjusted: [Skill: Avoidance] Weakened, probability reduced by 10%.
Adjusted: [Skill: Bursting Bloodlines] Changed to consume cards.
Fixed: [Skill: Temptation] bug where it could be cast without enemies.
Fixed: [Skill: Dagger Rain] bug where it was affected by our side's dodge status.

notes.title: April 18th Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Open to the 6th generation.
[*] New: [Relic:Crown Of Strength] Gain +1 Strength at the end of each turn.
[*] New: [Relic: Mask Of Reprisal] Whenever an enemy uses an upgraded card, they lose -5 Strength.
[*] New: [Relic: Staff Of Power] Gain an additional +3 Strength each time you shuffle your deck.
[*] Adjustment: Talent system overhaul; changed to in-game levels where talent points are earned through campaign progression.
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Retreat] Successfully fleeing will now count as completing the level.
[*] Adjustment: After unlocking up to the 5th generation, you can freely choose skills to build your initial deck at the start of the game.
[*] Fix: [Talent: Transaction] Fixed an issue where the shop could not refresh.
[/list]

notes.title: April 15th Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: [Relic: Bone Club] At the end of the turn, if there are no cards in hand, gain strength.
[*] Adjustment: Tip text size increased for clearer visibility.
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Coin Tower] changed from consumption to destruction after use (to prevent coin farming).
[*] Adjustment: [Skill: Invincibility] The number of layers gained is no longer related to rage, but is directly received.
[*] Adjustment: Traps and towers will no longer take thorn damage when attacking enemies with thorns.
[*] Adjustment: The position of monsters will not change due to changes in the land tile positions.
[*] Fix: [Skill: Shockwave] will not be able to open tiles with flying monsters above them.
[*] Fix: Errors caused by internal random seed.
[*] Fix: The issue where the points of [Relic: Horn] did not reset after battle ends.
[*] Fix: The problem where [Event: Grandfather's Gift] could not be exited.
[*] Fix: Various reported bugs.
[/list]
